decision.reason: [ev-2e2644c3f5f9] is just a one-line PR title saying the OLM installation and release docs were removed, filed under BREAKING CHANGES. It doesn't say whether OLM distribution or support itself was dropped (for example, the bundle no longer being published) or whether only the documentation changed. So the consequence for operators who install through OLM can't be determined. The PR #4617 description or the OLM bundle/release artifacts would be needed to say what happens to OLM-based installs.
